topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: A broad first intake must cover all major plan areas from the user-provided full software plan, not collapse to one narrow story.

Primary scope: .cursor/commands/intake.md, .cursor/agents/po.mdc, scripts/intake_evidence_lib.py, scripts/intake_evidence_validate.py, docs/product/backlog.md, docs/product/acceptance.md, docs/product/vision.md, handoffs/po_to_tl.md, plus template parity surfaces.
Keep US-0051/US-0068/US-0078 contracts and low-touch parity. Risk: over-strict interpretation could force excessive granularity; mitigation: allow explicit deferred rationale per plan area.
Add fixtures for broad-first-intake full coverage pass, justified defer pass, and missing plan-area mapping fail. Validate deterministic reason code and no-write fail-closed behavior.
Done means first broad intake persistence is blocked unless every identified plan area is mapped to at least one story or explicit defer rationale with evidence refs.
